review: The Rupture of FangHunt Hong Lu, the kit of Devyat Rodion, and the Blunt of The One Who Shall Grip Sinclair, all of this to create the perfect 00 ID in disguise. Now you may be wondering why? It is because of his Rupture application being paired with conditionals that not only stop inflicting Rupture but continue its consumption. Adding on to the woes, with no Damage% buffs from Courier Trunk - Sinclair (which Devyat Rodion has access to) makes him barely better or even worse than The One Who Shall Grip Sinclair in some cases. And if that wasn’t enough already, he also has the Devyat timer mechanic. Well, that's enough ranting, now let’s move on to his unique mechanic. Devyat Sinclair gains 3 Stacks of Courier Trunk - Sinclair at every turn start, up to 2 on Skill 1 and up to 3 on Skill 2.
